name: MESI
old_description: MESI provides Custom Electronic Design, PCB Design, Embedded Systems Design, Firmware development, Prototyping & Contract Manufacturing Services covering a wide area in the electronics domain. Since 1982, we are in the business of design & manufacture of various types of custom electronic products at affordable costs while delivering high quality of work. Contact us for your custom electronic product development & manufacturing needs.
about:
MESI, an electronics design and contract manufacturing firm, has operated from Rock Spring, Georgia since its founding in 1982. The company began as a provider of custom electronic design services and has since expanded into full-turnkey manufacturing of printed circuit board assemblies and electromechanical systems.

The company offers a comprehensive suite of services spanning electronic product design, PCB layout (two-layer and multi-layer), embedded systems development using 8-, 16-, and 32-bit microcontrollers and FPGAs, firmware engineering, prototyping, and volume production. In-house capabilities include schematic capture, bill-of-materials generation, parts procurement, surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly, box-build integration, cable and wire-harness fabrication, test-fixture design, encapsulation, rework, and supply-chain management. MESI handles projects from a single prototype through full turnkey production runs.

MESI serves a broad client base that includes large industrial companies, small businesses, and individual entrepreneurs across multiple sectors. The firm does not publicize a specific industry focus but emphasizes its ability to scale services for projects of any size.

The company differentiates itself through an efficient parts-procurement process, design-for-manufacturability reviews, consistent on-time delivery, direct personal contact without phone menus, and tight coupling of hardware and software design with manufacturing. MESI positions itself as an extension of its customers' engineering teams, aiming to reduce overhead while maintaining quality.

name: MPS Plastics Inc
old_description: Unique among Connecticut injection molders, MPS Plastics is the premier New England custom injection molder specializing in injection molds, insert molding, plastic molded parts, product design, plastics engineering, tool making, mold making, finishing, and CAD/CAM.
about:
MPS Plastics has operated in Marlborough, Connecticut, for over 40 years. The company was established in the region known for mold-making tradition and serves customers across the United States. No founder names or ownership structure are disclosed publicly.

The company provides full-service custom injection molding, including product design, plastics engineering, tool and mold making, molding, assembly, and finishing. In-house tooling is supported by CNC milling machines and EDM equipment, while design work uses SOLIDWORKS, CADKEY, FASTCAD, and Virtual Gibbs software.

MPS Plastics serves the automotive, biomedical, telecommunications, and consumer industries, working with engineers, purchasing agents, and inventors. The molder processes virtually all thermoplastics, from commodity grades to exotic high-performance engineering resins such as ABS and Zytel.

The company emphasizes cost-effectiveness and personal attention, offering fast quotes, on-time delivery, and extensive engineering collaboration. A proprietary "time-share" molding technique aims to reduce tooling costs for suitable projects. ISO 9001:2015 and ITAR certifications support work in regulated sectors.

name: MTM Molded Products
old_description: With over five decades of experience, MTM Molded Products has built a reputation for excellence in plastic manufacturing. Our commitment to using top-grade materials and advanced injection molding technology ensures every product meets the highest standards. about:
MTM Molded Products was founded in 1968 in Dayton, Ohio, as a family-owned operation. What began as a small injection molding shop has remained under family ownership for over five decades.

The company specializes in injection-molded plastic storage products, including boxes, carrying cases, toolboxes, dry boxes, and belt boxes. Using living-hinge designs and prime-grade resins, they produce over 100 standard styles in 20 colors, with customization options such as hot stamping, pad printing, foam inserts, and labeling. The cases feature mechanical latches for secure closure and extra-thick walls for impact resistance. Production runs range from 500 units to 250,000-plus.

Their customers include professionals and organizations requiring durable storage for tools, equipment, and valuables, with the company serving both standard catalog orders and custom-branded solutions. The firm notes its solutions are by pros who need gear that lasts.

MTM emphasizes American manufacturing, family-owned continuity, and personalized support, positioning its combination of time-tested craftsmanship and modern technology as a differentiator. The company highlights its on-site support team that guides clients from design through delivery.

name: MV Circuit Breakers
old_description: In 1998, owners Brad Goebel and Steve Wallem founded MV Breakers (formerly known as MV Liquidators) in a friend's garage in Mission Viejo, CA. Brad and Steve traveled around the country buying new circuit breaker inventory from contracting firms in order to provide their customer base with the lowest prices possible. As Brad and Steve’s relationships with these contracting firms grew, so did MV Breakers inventory.
about:
MV Circuit Breakers began in 1998 when Brad Goebel and Steve Wallem founded the company, then called MV Liquidators, in a friend's garage in Mission Viejo, California. The pair traveled across the country purchasing new circuit breaker inventory from contracting firms to offer customers the lowest possible prices, and their supplier relationships expanded the available stock over time.

The business operates as a distributor of residential and commercial circuit breakers and electrical components, carrying thousands of SKUs from brands such as Siemens, Square D, Eaton, Cutler‑Hammer, GE, Murray, and obsolete lines including Zinsco, Pushmatic, Challenger, and Federal Pacific. A retail location opened in 2005 at 23881 Via Fabricante in Mission Viejo. The company sells primarily new breakers alongside professionally tested used units, offers same‑day delivery in Southern California, same‑day shipping nationwide, free shipping on orders over $150, a one‑year warranty, and in‑store pickup.

Customers include electricians, contractors, and homeowners across residential, commercial, and construction sectors. Reviews highlight the ability to source hard‑to‑find breakers within 24 hours and provide emergency support, with one electrician noting he refers all his contacts to the company.

Goebel and Wallem started the venture to leverage contracting‑firm relationships for competitive pricing, and the company emphasizes its wide selection, rapid fulfillment, and personalized service as key differentiators.

name: Madison County Metalwork
old_description: Founded in 2021 by three local tradesmen with over 60 years combined experience in fabrication and machining, Madison County Metalwork is a business dedicated to the art of fine metal crafting. From custom fabrication to precision machining, we approach every project as a unique opportunity to apply years of knowledge and experience to provide the best product at the most affordable price.
about:
Madison County Metalwork was founded in 2021 in Norfolk, Nebraska, by three local tradesmen—Josh Bailey, Ryan Showalter, and Brian Wolfe—who together brought more than 60 years of combined fabrication and machining experience. The partners formed the company to provide custom fabrication and machine work to the surrounding region, drawing on backgrounds that ranged from Army service and laser-department management to formal training in welding, tool-and-die, and collision repair.

The shop specializes in full-custom machining and fabrication, offering welding, CNC milling, turning, grinding, heat treating, wire EDM, and laser cutting. While the facility size and headcount are not publicly disclosed, the founders’ expertise spans a multitude of materials and processes, allowing the company to handle projects from prototype through production runs for a variety of industrial sectors.

Customers come from medical, food-processing, rubber, steel, ethanol, and agricultural industries, reflecting the founders’ prior work in area job shops. The company serves regional manufacturers and OEMs that require precision metal components and fabricated assemblies.

The business was started with a mission to deliver precise, quality metalwork while excelling in its trade specialties and expanding its service offerings. The partners emphasize a hands-on, project-by-project approach, applying decades of practical knowledge to each job.

old_description: Mainca USA was founded in 2001 as a partnership between Dale Schmidt and Mainca Equipamentos Carnicos S.L. of Barcelona Spain to help expand Mainca’s North American distribution of quality meat and food processing equipment. With Dale’s 25 years of experience working for and managing the Schmidt family’s meat processing equipment distribution company (founded in 1942), it was a natural progression for Dale to move into the importation and distribution business. From then on, Mainca USA was immediately ready to provide the finest in quality equipment to the industry Dale knows best.
about:
Mainca USA Inc. is headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri. The company was founded in 2001 as a partnership between Dale Schmidt and Mainca Equipamentos Carnicos S.L. of Barcelona, Spain, to expand Mainca's North American distribution of meat and food processing equipment. Dale Schmidt brought 25 years of experience from managing his family's meat processing equipment distribution business, which had been operating since 1942.

Mainca USA imports and distributes European-made equipment for the meat and food processing industries through a network of more than 100 distributors across the United States and Canada. The product lineup includes brands such as Mainca, Jeros, Suhner, Gaser, and Lorenzo Barroso. Notable equipment includes the PQ- a hydraulic stuffer-driven double clipping system described as the first of its kind.

The company serves meat and food processors, particularly small to medium-sized operations seeking speed, accuracy, and portioning capabilities. Its distributor network reaches processors throughout North America, providing equipment for production lines that require reliable clipping, stuffing, and processing machinery.

The venture was built on the combination of Dale Schmidt's deep industry knowledge and Mainca's European manufacturing expertise. Mainca USA emphasizes quality, value, and dependability, positioning itself as a source for durable, reliable equipment and unique systems like the hydraulic stuffer-driven double clipper that are not available elsewhere.

name: Maine Commercial Solar
old_description: Get to know Maine Commercial Solar, a leading Solar Energy Equipment Installer. Our company was founded in 2020 when our founder, Jason Stutheit, noticed there was a gap between industry needs and what contractors were offering. Since then, we have been growing in both size and reputation at an astonishing rate. We lead the way in customer care and satisfaction, and we strive to provide the very best service to everyone we work with.
about:
Maine Commercial Solar was founded in 2020 by Jason Stutheit in Hermon, Maine. Stutheit started the company after identifying a gap between what solar contractors offered and the actual needs of the industry. The business operates from Hermon and serves customers across the state.

The company provides full-service solar solutions including system design, installation, and ongoing maintenance. It also sells solar components such as inverters, light fixtures, panels, and ground-mount helical piles, and offers packaged DIY kits for self-installation. In addition, Maine Commercial Solar rents land for community solar farms in Central Maine Power and Versant (Emera) utility territories, allowing customers to host systems off-site.

Its customer base spans construction firms, commercial property owners, and residential homeowners. The firm works with major panel brands including REC, Canadian Solar, LG, Solaria, and Q-CELLS, and advertises panel pricing starting at $0.53 per watt.

Stutheit launched the venture to deliver more responsive service and transparent pricing than he saw in the market. The company emphasizes direct communication and aims to be the sole supplier and installer for its clients, highlighting quick turnaround and personalized support as key differentiators.

name: Maine Energy Experts
old_description: Maine Energy Experts specializes in comprehensive renewable energy solar project development, delivering innovative, sustainable solutions for a cleaner future, including advanced solar installed in Maine.
about:
Maine Energy Experts is based in Buxton, Maine, and was founded in 2021 by Samuel Legere, Cameron Kerr‑Cavanagh, and Corey Levy. The company traces its start to Legere knocking on doors during a Maine winter, aiming to give homeowners an alternative to rising utility rates controlled by a foreign‑owned power monopoly.

The firm installs solar photovoltaic systems, high‑efficiency heat pumps, and roofing for residential and commercial customers across southern Maine. Its services include system design, permitting, installation, and ongoing maintenance, supported by a crew of installers, project managers, and administrative staff. The company says it has completed hundreds of installations and offers a “bill‑swap” program that replaces a typical $250 monthly electric bill with a fixed $200 solar payment.

Customers are primarily Maine homeowners and businesses seeking to lower energy costs and gain independence from Central Maine Power. The company cites examples of homeowners who have cut heating and cooling expenses by pairing solar with heat pumps, achieving a combined payback as short as 2.5 years.

Legere and his partners say they started the business to make the switch to solar simple, transparent, and enjoyable — emphasizing honest communication, industry‑warranties, and a goal of helping 10,000 Maine families become power independent.

old_description: Maine Technology Group was founded in 2012 with a straightforward mission: to provide businesses with reliable, no-nonsense IT services that keep operations running smoothly. Frustrated by providers that overcomplicate technology and push unnecessary solutions, we built a company focused on fast response times, clear communication, and practical, business-driven IT support. From the start, we committed to delivering IT services that align with what businesses truly need—nothing more, nothing less.
about:
Maine Technology Group was founded in 2012 in Oakland, Maine, with a mission to deliver reliable, no-nonsense IT services to businesses across the state. The company was started out of frustration with providers that overcomplicated technology and pushed unnecessary solutions, choosing instead to focus on fast response times, clear communication, and practical, business-driven IT support.

The firm provides managed IT services, VoIP solutions, specialized IT support for nonprofits, and fleet technology services. Its offerings include proactive monitoring and maintenance, cybersecurity measures, strategic IT planning, and consultation, all backed by a guaranteed one-hour emergency response time and a 100% satisfaction guarantee. The company emphasizes eliminating technical jargon and tailoring solutions to actual business needs rather than selling add-ons.

Maine Technology Group serves Maine-based organizations across sectors including legal, financial services, and nonprofit healthcare and social services. Current clients include law firms such as Bloomer-Russell-Beaupain, financial groups like Thompson Financial Group, and nonprofits such as Becket Maine, which relies on the company for secure, compliant systems that support care delivery.

The company was founded to address a gap in the market where IT providers prioritized sales over service, to overcomplicated systems and bloated contracts. Its stated differentiators are rapid response, honest communication, proactive problem prevention, and long-term partnerships built on trust, with the goal of making IT reliable enough that clients rarely have to think about it.
